method: Read-only Supabase get_advisors(type=security) on the fixed staging project after the separately recorded exact helper upgrade.

comparison.limitations: The prior receipt retained scoped object details and aggregate counts for unrelated advisories. Matching unrelated counts does not prove every unrelated finding identity is unchanged.

assessment: No advisor finding names either cleanup helper function. The same twelve Debate/Study admission RLS-without-policy INFO object identities remain, consistent with the intentionally service-only tables and separately verified privileges. Aggregate counts match the prior receipt: 245 INFO and 13 WARN findings. All returned unrelated findings are preserved below; none was altered or dismissed.
remainingVerificationGaps: Security advisors are not a complete security audit or approval for production release.
The separate upgrade receipt supplies actual function-body, ACL and role-denial proof; this advisor read does not rerun those SQL probes.
